memory_candidates.content: When Literature subdirectories already contain pre-chunked .md files but lack chunks.json manifests, generate manifests from Literature/index.json metadata using Python rather than running literature-chunk.sh. The index.json has title, keywords, summary per entry which maps directly to the chunks.json schema. Use sha256(doc_id + title + filename[:64])[:16] for chunk_id consistency.
